title: I have so many similarities to everyone's descriptions but I lack the consistency of experience many people seem to have
content: I love this sub. I've had these dreams for years, basically my(f 38) whole life. the older I get, the more intense and real the dreams feel. I also seem to be more actively doing something (although I don't know what) as opposed to being lost and wandering aimlessly, which is how these kinds of dreams usually played out until fairly recently. I relate to SO many elements that are described here, the mall, school, airport, hotel, the creepy dirty exposed bathrooms, etc something that I don't relate to however is the consistency that many people have, such as having a job or returning to the same mall/school/hotel/airport etc. and being able to describe these things in such detail. I have the same feeling and I get this certain "vibe" that connects these dreams in my head but they all seem incredibly individual and unique. I have never returned to the same "location". I have this sense that they are all the same kind of dream, I get this same unique feeling that I can't really describe and have never felt in any other context but it's essentially a new dream every time. does anyone else experience it like this? anyone who now has that consistency but previously didn't?
